messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — Helix (acct 8462) just told me they're leaning toward downgrading next billing cycle. Onboarding had a 6-week delay and they hit a latency regression after the last model swap. Tash said "it's getting expensive for the value". Need a concrete save plan by EOD Friday.

Jamal (CS Ops): +1. I can draft a structured downgrade path that preserves data and gives them breathing room. Quick Q: do we want to offer a temporary credit, or push a lower-tier 'grace' plan with support hours?

Priya (RevOps): Financial guardrails: manager approval needed for any discount > 25%. We can approve up to 25% at AM level for up to 3 months if it's tied to enablement milestones. Anything >25% needs RevOps + Sales signoff.

Eli (Support): We can prioritize the latency bug — if it's in our backlog, I can move it to hotfix. Need customer's error IDs and a repro window. Tash, can you paste the failing request IDs or a short repro?

Maya (CSM): Tash pasted logs in DM. Repro window 2026-03-10 14:12–14:25 UTC.

Noah (Solutions): Recommend a two-track save approach so we don't force a single option:
```
Option A — Save + Enablement (preferred)
- 3-month 20% credit on invoice 1
- Dedicated onboarding sessions (4 x 1hr) + tailored prompt templates
- SLA for bug fix (P2 -> P1) with weekly status
- Metrics check at 30/60/90 days

Option B — Grace Downgrade (less risky for us)
- Downgrade to Starter plan for 2 billing cycles
- Preserve data export and KV retention for 6 months
- Limited tokens/calls but reduced cost; option to re-upgrade with no penalties
```

Jamal (CS Ops): Love that. Add an explicit rollback/fallback for them: automatic up-regrade trigger if usage exceeds threshold. Also include an escape hatch email template.

Maya (CSM): Drafting customer-facing copy now. Quick draft for review: "Tash — we value Helix and want to make sure you see ROI. Two straightforward options: a short-term credit + enablement track, or a temporary downgrade that keeps your data intact and gives you time to reassess. Which would you prefer? Happy to hop on a call tomorrow to walk through either." Thoughts?

Priya (RevOps): Tone is good. Please add explicit timelines and the approval path: e.g., "We can implement Option A within 7 business days once approved. Credits up to 20% can be applied at CSM level; >20% requires RevOps approval."

Maya (CSM): Updated message and sent to Tash.

Tash (Acct Owner): Thanks — appreciate the options. My leadership prefers the grace downgrade (Option B) if we can guarantee data retention and a milestone to revisit in 60 days. Can we also cap any rate limits so our internal apps don't fail?

Eli (Support): We can set conservative rate limits and provide a short config snippet for their engineers. Example: `rate_limit: 50rps` + burst window 10s. Will validate against their traffic pattern.

Jamal (CS Ops): I'll build the exact downgrade plan and the billing patch:
- 2-cycle Starter downgrade effective next invoice
- Data export + KV retention keys preserved for 6 months
- Re-upgrade waiver for migration fees within 90 days
- Notify accounts-payable and apply prorated credits for the first pro-rated cycle

Priya (RevOps): Marking approval: 20% cap OK. If CSM requests 25–30% we need a short justification doc. I'll pre-approve the 20% credit tied to the enablement schedule.

Maya (CSM): Action items: Jamal to finalize downgrade doc by tomorrow noon; Eli to confirm rate-limit config & push hotfix ETA; Noah to own the enablement schedule; Priya to queue the billing changes. I'll schedule a 30-min call with Tash for Thurs 11am PT.

deploy-bot: reminder — meeting scheduled with Helix (acct 8462) set for 2026-03-26 18:00 UTC.

Noah (Solutions): Quick note: include a short eval checklist during the 60-day revisit: latency baseline, token cost per call, feature usage (vector search, streaming). Helps us measure ROI to discuss re-upgrade.

Maya (CSM): Agreed. I'll add the checklist to the customer notes.

Tash (Acct Owner): That sounds fair. Thank you all — we'll take Option B for now. Please send the formal downgrade confirmation and the rate-limit config.

Maya (CSM): Copy that. Sending confirmation now and will attach the rate-limit snippet + next steps. Will follow up after the call. :white_check_mark: 

Eli (Support): Logged hotfix ticket #SUP-1098 and set SLA to 7 business days.

Jamal (CS Ops): Downgrade doc uploaded to the Helix account folder and billing patch queued. Linking in thread: https://internal.redwood/heli x/8462/plan-change (private link)

Priya (RevOps): I'll monitor invoices and confirm credit applied after next cycle closes.

Maya (CSM): Great work team. We'll treat this as a template for future "grace downgrade" saves — capture lessons after 60-day review. :memo:
